web.headerTagline: Supports at-home tracking · Not a substitute for a vet visit

signin.disclaimerBadge: Not a substitute for a vet visit
signin.headline: Track your cat's urine pH through the color of litter granules
signin.subheadline: Photograph the litter tray after your cat uses it — CatCheck reads the color of the indicator granules, places the result in a reference pH band and saves it so you can see changes over time.
signin.phNote: Each scan is placed in one of the bands above.
signin.phError: Couldn't load the reference pH bands.
signin.feature1Body: Reads the color of indicator granules from a phone photo.
signin.feature2Body: Compared with your cat's own usual level, not based on a single reading.
signin.formSubtitle: View your cat's scan history, pH trends and tracking reminders.
signin.divider: Or sign in with your personal email
signin.securityBody: CatCheck only processes data for the purposes you agree to. You can review and change your choices at any time.

steps.headerTitle: Set up a tracking account for your cat

signup.formTitle: Sign up for a CATCHECK account
signup.formSubtitle: Save scan results and track your cat's pH changes over time.
signup.divider: OR FILL IN THE FULL FORM
signup.packagesTitle: Scans included with each litter package
signup.packagesBody: Each CatCheck litter bag has an activation code printed on the packaging. Enter the code after signing up to receive your scans.
signup.previewEmptyBody: After verifying your email, you'll enter your cat's name, breed, sex, date of birth and weight.
signup.value1Body: Indicator granules change color with urine pH; CatCheck reads the color from a photo and places it in a reference band.
signup.value2Body: Charts show changes compared with your cat's own usual level.
signup.value3Title: Export a report for vet visits
signup.value3Body: Export your tracking history to PDF so you can share it with your vet.

otp.title: Verify your email address
otp.subtitle: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to:
otp.submit: CONFIRM CODE & CONTINUE TO CAT PROFILE
otp.noticeBody: The OTP is normally valid for 5 minutes. If you don't see it in your inbox, please check your Spam or Promotions folder.
otp.pendingNext: After verifying, you'll create your cat's profile in the next step.
otp.whyBody: A verified email helps CatCheck reach the right person:
otp.why1Body: Only the person with access to this inbox can activate the account.
otp.why2Body: Password reset codes are sent to this email when you need them.
otp.why3Body: If you turn on email tracking reminders, they'll be sent to this address.
otp.supportBody: The CatCheck team offers support by email and hotline.
